system.boundary: Build an eight-module series battery pack with coupled electrical, thermal, and liquid-cooling dynamics.
engineering_objects: F90-XBATT-02 plant and controller described by the current public task contract
Measured output interfaces: pack_state, module_state, cooling_state, thermal_flux
physical_paths: The same physical pack current must pass through all eight module electrical paths, each module's electrical loss must heat its own thermal state, and coolant heat removal must act through the corresponding thermal balance.

Regulate the hottest measured module with a bounded pump actuator whose electrical power is at most 500 W, and draw that auxiliary power from the same battery pack rather than reporting it as a disconnected diagnostic.
functional_paths: Regulate the hottest measured module with a bounded pump actuator whose electrical power is at most 500 W, and draw that auxiliary power from the same battery pack rather than reporting it as a disconnected diagnostic.
information_paths: ambient_temperature, coolant_inlet_temperature, initial_soc, current_demand, module_resistance_spread, coolant_maldistribution, load_step_time, regen_start_time -> F90-XBATT-02 plant/control path -> pack_state, module_state, cooling_state, thermal_flux
modes_and_events: Read ambient_temperature, coolant_inlet_temperature, initial_soc, current_demand, module_resistance_spread, coolant_maldistribution, load_step_time, and regen_start_time from base-workspace variables.

Generate the requested traction-current cycle from current_demand: 0.55 times current_demand before load_step_time, 1.20 times current_demand until regen_start_time, -0.35 times current_demand for the next 30 s, and 0.80 times current_demand thereafter.

interfaces.name: pack_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log four complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named pack_state, module_state, cooling_state, and thermal_flux. pack_state has 8 channels in this order: requested traction current (A), delivered traction current (A), pump auxiliary current (A), total pack current (A), pack terminal voltage (V), minimum module SOC (1), maximum module temperature (K), and limiting flag (boolean).

interfaces.name: module_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log four complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named pack_state, module_state, cooling_state, and thermal_flux. module_state has 24 channels: eight module terminal voltages (V), eight module SOC values (1), and eight module temperatures (K), in module 1--8 order within each group.

interfaces.name: cooling_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log four complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named pack_state, module_state, cooling_state, and thermal_flux. cooling_state has 19 channels in this order: normalized pump command (1), pump electrical power (W), coolant inlet temperature (K), eight branch mass flows (kg/s), and eight branch outlet temperatures (K).

interfaces.name: thermal_flux
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log four complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named pack_state, module_state, cooling_state, and thermal_flux. thermal_flux has 16 channels: eight module heat-generation rates followed by eight module coolant heat-removal rates, all in W and in module 1--8 order.

signs_and_coordinates: Positive current denotes discharge and negative current denotes regeneration.

pack_state has 8 channels in this order: requested traction current (A), delivered traction current (A), pump auxiliary current (A), total pack current (A), pack terminal voltage (V), minimum module SOC (1), maximum module temperature (K), and limiting flag (boolean).
module_state has 24 channels: eight module terminal voltages (V), eight module SOC values (1), and eight module temperatures (K), in module 1--8 order within each group.
feedback_and_control_causality: Regulate the hottest measured module with a bounded pump actuator whose electrical power is at most 500 W, and draw that auxiliary power from the same battery pack rather than reporting it as a disconnected diagnostic.
Logs must come from one causal pack and cooling simulation, not from precomputed answer waveforms or copies of workspace inputs.
